display.purpose: Mona Sans Variable — page and panel titles, boot-screen headline. Never labels or buttons.

body.purpose: Inter Variable — default body, file names, descriptions, control text.

label.purpose: Inter Variable — table headers, quota readouts, captions, ruled manifest headers (11px uppercase overline, 0.08em).

mono-data.purpose: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace — IDs, sizes, dates, status labels, progress readouts, webhook numbers, byte values. Never body copy or buttons.

shadows.name: panel-edge
shadows.purpose: Floating panels, menu popovers, hovered tiles.

shadows.name: command-strip
shadows.purpose: Selection bar / command strip, transfer console.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: State feedback for cell/row/control transitions (hover, focus, selection, reveal).

motion.name: split-flap
motion.purpose: State changes flip a character cell — status lamp, count, byte readout — nothing sweeps.

motion.name: spring-system
motion.purpose: Existing springs and DialogTransition APIs; no new motion library.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion: state changes become opacity-only, no transforms or flips.

breakpoints.name: rail-collapse
breakpoints.purpose: Fixed 240px manifest rail becomes app bar + temporary drawer; table/grid collapse to full-width cards with all actions always visible. Contractual — never moved.

breakpoints.name: public-asymmetric
breakpoints.purpose: Asymmetric public surfaces (login, share): brand/statement left, control panel right; stacked below.

breakpoints.name: narrow-console
breakpoints.purpose: Transfer console must not cover the viewport edge — maxWidth calc(100vw - 16px), left 8 fallback, safe-area-aware bottom padding.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action — amber rectangular control, dark text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #D9A441; color: #1B1408; padding: 10px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: none; font: 600 13px/1.2 'Inter Variable'; letter-spacing: 0.02em; transition: background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #E0AE52; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(217,164,65,0.18); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Graphite rectangular control — surface-2 fill with hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #1A2428; color: #F4F1E8; padding: 10px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(193,211,205,0.18); font: 600 13px/1.2 'Inter Variable'; letter-spacing: 0.02em; transition: background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #233036; border-color: rgba(193,211,205,0.28); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form fields — surface-1 fill, hairline border, amber focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #11181B; color: #F4F1E8; border: 1px solid rgba(193,211,205,0.18); border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 14px; font: 400 15px/1.45 'Inter Variable'; letter-spacing: -0.1px; transition: border-color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #9BA7A7; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(217,164,65,0.18); border-color: rgba(217,164,65,0.18); }

components.name: Dialog
components.description: Surface-2 matte panel, ruled header, dialog elevation, 12px corners; mono for URLs/IDs.
components.html:
New folder

Folders can contain files and other folders.
components.css: .ds-dialog { background: #1A2428; border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(193,211,205,0.12), 0 24px 64px rgba(0,0,0,0.55); color: #F4F1E8; } .ds-dialog h3 { font: 600 20px/1.25 'Inter Variable'; letter-spacing: -0.3px; margin: 0 0 16px; }

components.name: Entry Table Row
components.description: Ruled manifest row — canvas surface, surface-1 hover, surface-2 + signal marker selected; keyboard-visible action reveal.
components.css: .ds-row { cursor: pointer; } .ds-row td { padding: 10px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(193,211,205,0.10); color: #F4F1E8; font: 400 15px/1.45 'Inter Variable'; letter-spacing: -0.1px; } .ds-mono { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; color: #9BA7A7; } .ds-row:hover { background: #11181B; } .ds-row.selected { background: #1A2428; box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 #D9A441; }

components.name: Entry Grid Tile
components.description: Fixed-cell file tile — icon cell, name, mono metadata; signal border + signal-soft when selected.
components.css: .ds-tile { background: #11181B; border: 1px solid rgba(193,211,205,0.10); border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px; color: #F4F1E8; } .ds-tile.selected { border-color: #D9A441; background: rgba(217,164,65,0.18); } .ds-mono { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; color: #9BA7A7; }

components.name: Entry Cards
components.description: Same cell grammar stacked for touch; all actions always visible below 768px (no hover dependency).
components.css: .ds-card { background: #11181B; border: 1px solid rgba(193,211,205,0.10); border-radius: 12px; padding: 15px; color: #F4F1E8; } .ds-mono { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; color: #9BA7A7; }

components.name: Quota Readout
components.description: Compact signal readout — mono values, segmented/ruled progress track, exact 'X of Y used' copy.
components.html: 4.2 GiB of 10.0 GiB used
components.css: .ds-quota { color: #9BA7A7; border-radius: 6px; } .ds-mono { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 12px; }

components.name: Transfer Console
components.description: Fixed transfer console, not a floating card — ruled 'Uploads' header with active count, segmented progress, abort/retry/remove; safe-area-aware below 412px.
components.css: .ds-console { position: fixed; right: 16px; bottom: 16px; background: #1A2428; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(193,211,205,0.12), 0 16px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); color: #F4F1E8; } @media (max-width: 412px) { .ds-console { max-width: calc(100vw - 16px); left: 8px; right: 8px; } }

components.name: Drop Zone
components.description: Signal Deck drop-zone state — amber dashed ring with signal-soft fill; pointer-inert overlay.
components.css: .ds-drop { border: 2px dashed #D9A441; background: rgba(217,164,65,0.18); border-radius: 12px; pointer-events: none; color: #F4F1E8; }

components.name: Empty-State Panel
components.description: NO FILES / CHANNEL READY panel — surface-1, fixed-grid atmosphere, amber upload marker, one primary CTA. Exact strings: 'Your space is ready' / 'Your files are encrypted before they're stored — only you can see them.' / 'Upload your first file'.
components.html:
Your space is ready

Your files are encrypted before they're stored — only you can see them.
components.css: .ds-empty { background: #11181B; border: 1px solid rgba(193,211,205,0.10); border-radius: 12px; padding: 40px; text-align: center; color: #F4F1E8; } .ds-empty h2 { font: 500 28px/1.15 'Mona Sans Variable'; letter-spacing: -0.6px; margin: 15px 0 5px; } .ds-empty button { background: #D9A441; color: #1B1408; border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 15px; font: 600 13px/1.2 'Inter Variable'; }

narrative.overview: A private file system whose encrypted payloads move through Discord attachments deserves an instrument, not another dark SaaS card skin. Signal Deck is a split-flap operations board: matte graphite canvas, one amber signal, a local mono register for every measurement, and fixed-grid grammar — ruled headers, fixed character cells, status lamps, restrained steel inset edges — that makes storage state legible for a technical self-hosting operator. The category default it refuses: the centered SaaS dashboard of equal cards. Identity lives in the shell, the ruled rows, the state changes, and the task hierarchy, not in uniform tiles.
keyCharacteristics: Matte graphite canvas everywhere; no light mode, no white cards
One amber signal (#D9A441) for primary actions, selection, focus, drop targets
Semantic colors (success/danger/info) are states, never decoration
Local mono stack reserved for measurement: IDs, sizes, dates, status, byte values
Rectangular controls by radius role — no pill-button system, no circular icon buttons
Fixed 240px manifest rail; ruled tables and fixed-cell tiles
Split-flap state vocabulary: 140–220ms transitions, one-character flips, no page-load choreography
Cross-surface story: boot screen, live file manifest, storage control room, recovery ledger, guided check-in, transfer manifest
Cloud-drive side rail; monochrome file-type glyphs
No gradients, no violet, no glass, no glow

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Amber is the single primary signal — primary actions, selection, focus, drop targets, active route marker. Never a second amber, never amber as decorative fill, never a different primary color.

rules.name: The Mono Measurement Rule
rules.body: Anything that is a measurement or identity — IDs, sizes, dates, status labels, progress readouts, webhook numbers, byte values — is set in ui-monospace/SFMono-Regular/Consolas. Prose is never mono; body copy and buttons never are.

rules.name: The No-Pill Rule
rules.body: Every control is a rectangle in its radius class (panels 12px, cells 6px, controls 8px, icon actions 8px). No pill buttons, no circular icon buttons, no ghost buttons with transparent fills.

rules.name: The Flat-Graphite Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat matte graphite at rest. Steel inset edges and panel-edge shadows mark floating; nothing glows, no gradients, no glass. If a surface looks lit from inside, the system is drifting.

dos: Keep canvas and ink as the two anchor surfaces; use surface-1/2/3 as measured steps.
Reserve amber for the primary signal — actions, selection, focus, drop targets.
Set measurements and identities (IDs, sizes, dates, status, byte values) in the mono register.
Compose every control as a rectangle in its radius class; keep the no-pill, no-circle discipline.
Mark floating with steel inset edges and panel-edge shadows; keep everything else matte.
Keep state feedback at 140–220ms with split-flap flips; honor reduced motion with opacity-only changes.
Show the task and the primary action in the first viewport on every route.
donts: Ship a light surface anywhere, or any white pill CTA — the world is graphite, the CTA is amber.
Introduce gradients, violet, glass, or glow — the fixed-grid atmosphere is texture, not illumination.
Use semantic colors as decoration; success/danger/info mean states.
Reach for a second primary color or a second amber.
Set labels or buttons in the display face, or body copy in mono.
Color-code file types; the glyph carries the type, folders are ink and files are ink-muted.
